value.rationale: The complete-transposition Cayley metric is a canonical sequence of symmetric-group metric spaces. Its generalized roundness controls powered Hilbert embeddability; proving exponential collapse and an explicit asymptotic root upper rate is a structural all-family invariant, while exact initial thresholds identify the first obstruction irreps and endpoint embedding dimensions. The finding goes beyond a finite enumeration or a restatement of the classical character-content identity.
